review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. For the Honduran reviewer: "me duele la cabeza / me duelen los ojos" (doler like gustar); "tener fiebre"; "Dame la mano"; "estar enfermo / mejor / mal"; the PLAN also wants frío and sed here, but they are not in the word list yet.

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.text: Me duelen los ojos y me duele la boca.
sentences.english: My eyes hurt and my mouth hurts.

sentences.text: Luis tiene la mano en la cabeza de Nico.
sentences.english: Luis has his hand on Nico's head.

sentences.speaker: luis
sentences.english: Let us go to the clinic.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.english: I do not want to study today.

sentences.speaker: luis
sentences.english: You do not have to study.

sentences.speaker: luis
sentences.english: You have to go to Ana.

sentences.speaker: ana
sentences.text: Soy enfermera y voy a ayudar.
sentences.english: I am a nurse and I am going to help.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.english: I have a lot of pain.

sentences.speaker: ana
sentences.text: Tenés fiebre, pero no es mucha.
sentences.english: You have a fever, but not a high one.

sentences.speaker: daniel
sentences.english: Do you have pain in your eyes?

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.text: Sí, y en la boca también.
sentences.english: Yes, and in my mouth too.

sentences.speaker: daniel
sentences.english: Nico does not need the hospital.

sentences.speaker: daniel
sentences.english: He needs water and more water.

sentences.speaker: ana
sentences.text: Hay mucha gente en la clínica hoy.
sentences.english: There are many people at the clinic today.

sentences.text: Nico está en la casa con doña Marta.
sentences.english: Nico is at home with doña Marta.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Es mejor estar en la cama.
sentences.english: It is better to be in bed.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: Luis, does Nico have a fever?

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Doña Marta, what do you need?

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Necesito pollo para la sopa de Nico.
sentences.english: I need chicken for Nico's soup.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Yo voy a la tienda del señor Carlos.
sentences.english: I am going to Mr. Carlos's shop.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Good morning, Mr. Carlos. Do you have chicken?

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Es caro, pero Nico necesita sopa.
sentences.english: It is expensive, but Nico needs soup.

sentences.text: Doña Marta hace sopa de pollo.
Nico come un plato de sopa.
sentences.english: Nico eats a plate of soup.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.text: Me gusta la sopa de pollo.
Luis tiene mucho trabajo en la escuela.
sentences.english: Luis has a lot of work at school.

sentences.speaker: luis
sentences.english: I am going to school, grandma.

sentences.speaker: luis
sentences.text: Nico está enfermo hoy, pero va a estar mejor.
sentences.english: Nico is sick today, but he is going to get better.

sentences.text: En la tarde el equipo viene a visitar a Nico.
sentences.english: In the afternoon the team comes to visit Nico.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Vamos a estar aquí con vos.
sentences.english: We are going to be here with you.

sentences.text: Sam toma la mano de Nico.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.text: Nico, mañana vas a estar bien.
sentences.english: Nico, tomorrow you will be fine.

sentences.speaker: karla
sentences.text: La señora Elena de la pulpería tiene pan.
sentences.english: Señora Elena from the shop has bread.

sentences.speaker: luis
sentences.text: Nico, ¿querés ir a la escuela mañana?
sentences.english: Nico, do you want to go to school tomorrow?

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.english: Yes, I want to go with you.

sentences.speaker: luis
sentences.text: Tenés que comer bien y tomar agua.
sentences.english: You have to eat well and drink water.

sentences.speaker: ana
sentences.text: Y tenés que estar en la cama hoy.
sentences.english: And you have to be in bed today.

sentences.speaker: ana
sentences.text: Yo siempre estoy en la clínica.
sentences.english: I am always at the clinic.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Gracias a Dios, Nico está bien.
